=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:390-409 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED and MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED as default-`true` switches (`${{ vars.<NAME> || 'true' }}` in orchestrate_poll.yml, review_autofix.yml, cancel_on_pr_close.yml and README.md), but scripts/stage_switches.json has no entry for either.
  WHY: tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py::test_every_workflow_true_switch_is_in_registry (line 111) and ::test_every_readme_true_switch_is_in_registry (line 128, assert at 141) fail with `['MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED', 'MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED']` on head 924b7620d2ccdc1ecc26cdf3b969e71c2e1a90bd (run 45760420575, tests-system-python shards 12 and 14). That fails lint and ci/final, so the PR cannot merge, and the daily stage-switch watch can never alert on either switch (the #9994 failure mode). All four reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2335-3035 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-tick readiness cache (`_MT_LEASE_READY_CACHE` / `_mt_merge_lease_pr_ready_cached`, lines 2971-2974 and 3017-3035) returns the conflict-release scan's earlier ready result, including the ci/final state, even after the grant path re-runs `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` (lines 2335-2347 and 2784-2837) and fetches fresh statuses.
  WHY: If ci/final flips from success to pending between the scan and the grant, the lease can go to a waiter that is no longer ready. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, glm rated it NIT (the window is bounded to one tick and the caching is documented as intentional). sonnet and minimax checked this claim and rejected it as a false positive because the cache is reset at the top of `_mt_merge_lease_tick` (`scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2021`).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2335-2784 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` runs once in the `_mt_merge_lease_ready_waiter_exists` scan and again in the single-holder (~2335) and multi-holder (~2784) grant loops, so each scanned waiter's `commits/<head>/statuses` is read twice per conflict-release tick; only the `pulls/<pr>` read is cached.
  WHY: Nothing breaks functionally, but the extra REST calls (up to 10 candidates, only on conflict-release ticks) draw on the §14 API budget and are not mentioned in the agents.d fragment. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4005-4032 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The mergeable_state sanitizer `gsub("[^a-z_]"; "")` in `_merge_lease_pr_mergeable` silently coerces any value containing digits or hyphens to `-` or empty, and no log records the raw value.
  WHY: Unknown or empty values fail open, so nothing fails today; this is an observability gap only (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Repository convention (README "Stage switch watch"; tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py, introduced for #9994): every repository-variable switch whose default is `true` (`vars.<NAME>_ENABLED || 'true'`, or a README `_ENABLED` row with default `true`) must be listed in scripts/stage_switches.json so the off-switch watch covers it.
  expected_change_site: scripts/stage_switches.json, two new entries for MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED and MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED next to MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED (lines 400-404)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/stage_switches.json is not in the PR's changed files, grep finds 0 hits for either switch name (only the three existing MERGE_LEASE_* names), the workflows wire both with `vars.<NAME>_ENABLED || 'true'` and README.md documents both with default `true`, CI on head 924b7620d2ccdc1ecc26cdf3b969e71c2e1a90bd fails test_every_workflow_true_switch_is_in_registry (shard 12) and test_every_readme_true_switch_is_in_registry (shard 14) naming exactly these two switches (run 45760420575), and the lint job fails as a result. MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASED_LABEL needs no entry because the tests only flag `_ENABLED` rows.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:390-404 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The registry has entries for MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED (391), MERGE_LEASE_METRICS_ENABLED (396) and MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED (401), but none for MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED or MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED. The PR adds both as default `true` in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 301-302, 1612-1613, 1872-1873 and 2038-2039), .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (lines 1228-1229, 4795-4796 and 4926-4927), .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml (lines 427-428) and the README.md "#### Variables" rows.
  WHY: tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py::test_every_workflow_true_switch_is_in_registry (line 111, shard 12) and ::test_every_readme_true_switch_is_in_registry (line 128, assert at 141, shard 14) fail on head 924b7620d2ccdc1ecc26cdf3b969e71c2e1a90bd (run 45760420575). Lint and ci/final fail, so the PR cannot merge, and scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh would never alert on either switch (the #9994 failure mode). Fix: add two entries with only the keys {name, default:"true", stage} after MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED, because test_registry_entries_are_well_formed (line 152) allows only name, default, stage and on_values.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_ready_waiter_exists / single-holder and multi-holder grant loops | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` runs again for the same waiters, so `commits/<head>/statuses` is read twice for each scanned waiter (up to 10); only the `pulls/<pr>` read is cached, by _mt_merge_lease_pr_ready_cached.
  WHY: Nothing breaks. The cost is extra REST calls against the §14 budget, only on the conflict-release path, and the agents.d fragment does not mention them.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Repository convention (README "Stage switch watch"; tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py): every repository-variable switch whose default is `true` must be listed in scripts/stage_switches.json.
  Expected change site: scripts/stage_switches.json, two new entries for MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED and MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED, next to MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED (lines 400-404).
  Evidence of absence: The file is not in the PR's changed files, a search finds only the three existing MERGE_LEASE_* names, and CI fails both registry tests. Same root cause as the CORRECTNESS blocker.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING (scripts/stage_switches.json, after the MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED object at lines 400-404): add the two `{"name", "default": "true", "stage"}` entries (estimated 10 lines changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Notes: rejected the readiness-cache staleness claim (the cache is reset at the start of `_mt_merge_lease_tick` and lasts one tick) and the unchecked `tm_fb_since` arithmetic claim (`_merge_lease_read` already forces `MERGE_LEASE_UPDATED` to a number, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3158).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi readiness cache logic | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _MT_LEASE_READY_CACHE is not cleared or invalidated when eligibility re-verifies candidates within the same tick, so a stale ready result may be reused after ci/final becomes pending.
  WHY: A merge lease could be granted to a waiter that is no longer ready, which violates the ready-first grant requirement.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2335 and 2784 (approximate calls to _merge_lease_pr_eligible) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: _merge_lease_pr_eligible runs several times for the same waiter candidates in the waiter scan and the grant loop, and the statuses read is not cached.
  WHY: The redundant REST calls consume the limited GitHub API budget.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Repository convention (README "Stage switch watch", tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py): every switch whose default is `true` must be listed in the stage-switch registry.
  Expected change site: scripts/stage_switches.json, alongside existing MERGE_LEASE_* entries.
  Evidence of absence: The file has no entries for MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED or MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED even though both default to `true` in the workflows and README, which causes CI failures on lint and the system-python shards.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
